title: INTENT-OS RNOLA Operator Check Attachment v1
$comment: Durable record attaching an operator-check to a PR review or issue comment. This record links learning evidence to the artifact without modifying the artifact's authority. The operator-check itself remains advisory only.

kind.$comment: Where the operator-check is attached. pull_request_review_comment: attached to a PR review. issue_comment: attached to an issue comment. pr_description_block: embedded in PR description. review_thread: part of a review thread.

type.$comment: What kind of artifact this attachment is linked to

identifier.$comment: PR number or issue number (e.g., '534' for PR-534)

operator_check.$comment: The operator-check record being attached. Must conform to intent_os_operator_check_v1.schema.json via $ref validation.

attachment_reason.$comment: Why this operator-check is being attached. E.g., 'Z2 read this evidence before ratification' or 'Operator learning pass for review'.

attached_at.$comment: ISO 8601 timestamp when the record was created

attached_by.$comment: User or agent identity that attached this record (e.g., 'claude', 'Night', GitHub username)

linked_to_witness_ledger.$comment: If true, this record has been linked into the INTENT-OS Witness Ledger. The ledger linkage is a separate governance decision and does not happen by default.
